Post-merge evidence update for Gerrit change 2479:

- Change 2479 merged at 2026-09-02 00:20:20 UTC after PS6 reached Verified+1 and LLM-Review+1.
- I dispatched the post-merge main health run needed for the non-vacuous CI-log acceptance check: GitHub Actions run 33574990286 on merged SHA 5ff99170b5d0cf97f2f639f117f4b9337622ba33.
- Acceptance greps on that run:
  - `grep -F 'Successfully installed uv 0.12.7'` => exit 1 (no install success line)
  - `grep -F 'Fetching manifest data'` => exit 1
  - `grep -F 'raw.githubusercontent.com'` => exit 1
- Root cause of the failed success grep is a real composite-action parser bug exposed only once main used the new workflow/action definitions: PowerShell treats `$asset:` in `throw "Checksum mismatch for $asset: ..."` as an invalid variable reference. The action fails at parse time before downloading/installing uv.
- Continuing under this still-open ticket with a follow-up Gerrit change that fixes the parser bug and adds guard coverage, then I will rerun post-merge evidence before closing. No force overrides used.
